obligations.note: The change sets payments.privileged_idle_minutes to 16, exceeding the parametric bound of <= 15. The cited exception EXC-0253 is scoped to component 'mortgage.session' and the scope text 'Mortgage privileged sessions', not to payments; it does not cover this deviation.

The only exception that could cover a SES-1 deviation (EXC-0253) is scoped to 'mortgage.session', whereas the change modifies 'payments.policy' and 'payments.controls-data'. Per EXC-1 the exception must be scoped to the same obligation AND component; the component mismatch means the exception is invalid for this change.

Ticket CHG-26241 is approved by change manager grace.kim, and its components (payments.controls-data, payments.policy) cover both changed files (policy.py → payments.policy; policy-params.json → payments.controls-data).
Mara Costa (mara.costa@fernbrook.example) holds the change_approver role for payments and is not the author (Sofia Santos); her code_review approval is on the head commit.
Both approvals (code_review and control_owner) are for the single and only commit e650d92…, which is the head; no later commits exist to void them.
CI ran on the final commit e650d92 with 172 tests, 0 failures, 0 skipped; the registered control test test_privileged_idle_timeout_within_policy (SES-1) is present and passed.
The changed files map to components 'payments.policy' and 'payments.controls-data', both marked security_sensitive: false in components.json, so no security review is required.
The change touches controls/payments/policy-params.json (a protected path); Bao Tran (controls-office, control_owner role) approved it, and he is on a different team from the author (payments-eng).
Ticket CHG-26241 is of type 'standard', not 'emergency', so no post-implementation review is triggered.
No entry in the acceptance ledger covers apps/baseline-payments/payments/policy.py or controls/payments/policy-params.json, so no prior evidence lapses as a result of this change.

summary: The change raises the payments privileged idle timeout from 15 to 16 minutes, directly violating the SES-1 parametric bound of <= 15. The exception referenced in the change description (EXC-0253) is scoped to the 'mortgage.session' component, not to payments, and therefore cannot excuse the deviation under EXC-1's requirement that an exception match both the obligation and the component. All process obligations (ticket, independent approval, control-owner approval, CI) are satisfied, but the substantive control violation and the inapplicable exception force a rejection.
